Venue: Gate
Headline: Trenches 7-Day Check-in Sprint Phase 3: Triple Rewards, Share 40,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Trenches 7-Day Check-in Sprint Phase 3 is now live. During the campaign, trade Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone to unlock triple rewards, including Returning User Exclusive, Daily Check-in, and Trading Sprint, and share a total prize pool of 40,000 USDT. Keep sprinting after completing your check-ins, as rewards can be claimed at the same time.
You must first click the "Join Now" button to register, then trade Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone to be eligible for rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 20, 2026, 08:00 – November 27, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event Scope
Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone. Buy and sell volume are combined.
## Reward 1: Returning User Exclusive 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher
Returning users who trade Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone during the campaign and reach a cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 100 USDT will receive a 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Total Fee Rebate Voucher Pool: 10,000 USDT. Limited to 1 voucher per user, distributed in the order users meet the requirement, while supplies last.
This reward is exclusive to returning users. Returning users are users who have previously traded in Gate Trenches (including the former Gate Alpha) and have not traded in Trenches during the 7 days before the campaign starts. Returning users can also participate in Reward 2 and Reward 3.
## Reward 2: Daily Check-in, Share 10,000 USDT
During the campaign, registered users who trade Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach a daily cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 200 USDT will complete that day's check-in. Users who reach the following check-in tiers can claim the corresponding rewards. Total prize pool: 10,000 USDT, limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Cumulative Check-in Days | Reward
3 days | 2 USDT
5 days | 4 USDT
7 days | 7 USDT
Rewards are ranked by the time users first complete 3 days of check-ins (ties are ranked by registration order). Each user will receive only the highest tier reward achieved. Distribution stops when the remaining prize pool is insufficient for the next full reward.
## Reward 3: Trading Sprint, Share 20,000 USDT
Registered users who trade Robinhood chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach the corresponding cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) tier can share the corresponding prize pool. Each user will participate only in the prize pool for the highest tier achieved and will not participate in other tiers.
Rewards are distributed based on each user's share of the total trading volume in that tier.
Cumulative trading volume ≥ 3,500 USDT. Prize pool: 3,000 USDT. Maximum per user: 10 USDT
Cumulative trading volume ≥ 8,000 USDT. Prize pool: 5,000 USDT. Maximum per user: 25 USDT
Cumulative trading volume ≥ 16,000 USDT. Prize pool: 12,000 USDT. Maximum per user: 80 USDT
## Notes
Users must complete identity verification to claim campaign rewards.
Only trading volume generated after successful registration and during the campaign period will be counted. Trades made before registration are not included. Trading volume that does not reach the daily check-in threshold still counts toward cumulative trading volume.
Daily check-ins are counted by UTC+0 calendar day. A maximum of 1 check-in is counted per day, and check-ins do not need to be consecutive.
Rewards from this campaign cannot be shared with rewards from other campaigns, and rewards from campaigns of the same type cannot be stacked.
Please verify the token name, chain, and contract address before trading. If any token information is incorrect, please contact customer support.
Campaign page data will be updated within 1–2 hours. Displayed data and estimated rewards are for reference only, and final rewards will be calculated according to the campaign rules. All airdrop rewards will be distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. Due to token price fluctuations, the actual amount received shall prevail.
Rewards will be distributed within 7 working days after the campaign ends.
Fee Rebate Vouchers must be activated before use and cannot be withdrawn or transferred. Applicable markets, rebate ratio, and validity period are subject to the voucher details.
First-time Trenches users must follow the on-page instructions to confirm the Innovation Trading Disclaimer and related user agreements. Token projects may carry high risks and price volatility, so please participate with caution.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In the event of any discrepancy between language versions, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign and the right to adjust the relevant terms or cancel the campaign without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions are not eligible to participate. For details, please refer to the User Agreement. This campaign does not solicit or market to users in restricted regions.

Venue: Bitget
Headline: Futures Mining: A New Cycle Begins｜Thanksgiving Special, Share a 100,000 USDT Super Prize Pool!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## 1. Open your first position for a chance to win from the 30,000 USDT promotion pool!
First futures trade: Complete your first futures trade of at least 200 USDT during the promotion to earn 1 lucky draw chance.
First futures grid trade: Complete your first futures grid trade of at least 200 USDT during the promotion to earn 1 lucky draw chance.
First futures copy trade: Complete your first futures copy trade of at least 500 USDT during the promotion to earn 1 lucky draw chance.
2. Meet the trading milestones to unlock scratch cards from the 70,000 USDT promotion pool!
During the promotion, meet both the cumulative trading-day and cumulative trading-volume requirements to receive scratch card chances. All five tiers can be unlocked cumulatively, and trading days do not need to be consecutive. Receive up to 30 scratch card chances in total.
Tier 1: Accumulate ≥ 4 trading days and ≥ 40,000 USDT in Futures trading volume during the promotion to receive 2 scratch card chance.
Tier 2: Accumulate ≥ 6 trading days and ≥ 80,000 USDT in Futures trading volume during the promotion to receive 4 scratch card chances.
Tier 3: Accumulate ≥ 8 trading days and ≥ 100,000 USDT in Futures trading volume during the promotion to receive 6 scratch card chances.
Tier 4: Accumulate ≥ 10 trading days and ≥ 200,000 USDT in Futures trading volume during the promotion to receive 8 scratch card chances.
Tier 5: Accumulate ≥ 14 trading days and ≥ 300,000 USDT in Futures trading volume during the promotion to receive 10 scratch card chances.
## Reward distribution
Users must click the 【Register】 button to register before participating in the promotion.
Users may participate in both Promotion 1 and Promotion 2.
Promotion 1 (first-trade drawing): To participate in the first-trade task for a specific trade type, you must have no prior filled orders for that trade type before registering for the promotion.
Promotion 2 (trading milestones): Open to all registered users. Cumulative trading days do not need to be consecutive, and any valid trading day during the promotion will count. Rewards from all five tiers can be unlocked cumulatively, for up to 30 scratch card chances in total.
Drawing chances are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. Once all drawing chances have been distributed, task progress will no longer be updated for users who did not receive a chance.
Claimed but unused drawing chances will expire when the promotion ends. Any chances not used by the deadline will be deemed forfeited, along with the corresponding rewards.
All rewards will be distributed to users' accounts within 7 working days after the promotion ends.
Trading in the USDCUSDT stablecoin trading pair does not count toward the promotion's trading volume.
This promotion is only open to invited users.
## Registration restrictions
Sub-accounts, market makers, brokers, and institutional accounts are not eligible to register for the promotion.
At Bitget's sole discretion, all registered accounts and promotion rewards of users who employ any technical means to sign up—including but not limited to electronic, robotic, repetitive, automated, or similar methods—or to trade—including malicious volume inflation, improper matched orders, or similar methods—to achieve the objectives of the promotion will be immediately invalidated.
Bitget reserves the right of final interpretation of these terms and conditions, including but not limited to the right to modify, change, or cancel the promotion without prior notice. If you have any questions, please contact us.
